  1. FAQ

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Is this a ranking?

No. Norantz does not score, grade, or rank countries, governments, or reports. Each page counts its readings by label, always beside how much of the report has been reviewed. What each label means.

Is the analysis accurate?

We work hard to make it so, but every review is drafted with generative AI and may contain errors. Every figure has a date and a link, so you can check it in one step. If you find a mistake, tell us; corrections are dated and logged. How AI is used, and the errors to look out for.

How should I use a review?

As a conversation starter and a starting point for deeper, human-led discussion and analysis. A review gathers what a national plan said, the latest official figures, and what has changed since, in one place. Use it to open a discussion, prepare a workshop or a briefing, or decide where to look harder. Check what you rely on against the sources.

Who writes the reviews?

AI does the reading and the first draft, in the same steps for every report. A named person checks each stage before anything is published. The nine steps.

Why use AI?

So every report can be read the same way, at scale, and read again when new data arrives. Each page discloses what the AI did and what people checked.

Why this report and not another?

The catalogue lists every report in scope; reviews follow published criteria. How reports are chosen. You can suggest one.

Can the authors reply?

Yes, on the page itself. For report authors.

How often are reviews updated?

Each review shows the date of its next planned update. Every update gets a new fixed version, and the old one stays online.

How do I cite a review?

Cite the fixed version address. Data and citation.

How do I report an error?

Use the error form. Corrections are dated and logged.

By Plural Futures

Norantz (Basque for “towards where?”) is a second reading of national futures, by Plural Futures. It reads each report on its own terms, describes rather than grades, and shows its sources, coverage, and method on every page.

Reviews on this site are drafted with generative AI and may contain errors. Read them as a conversation starter and a starting point for deeper, human-led analysis.

Read generously. Check rigorously.
